Privacy and cookie statement

This statement explains how Nordhaus handles personal data, which cookies we set, and how long we keep records. Your payment data is processed by our payment service provider and is never stored on our servers.

If you book an event or a tour at the Nordhaus Museum, we collect your name, your contact details and a payment method in order to process the booking. We keep those records for seven years.
